title: tvOS 27 could push you to upgrade to new Apple TV 4K - 9to5Mac
summary: When Siri AI was unveiled at WWDC, it was announced for every Apple platform except two: Apple TV and HomePod. The new software doesn’t support the Apple TV HD or the first-gen Apple TV 4K.
